description: List every training and evaluation dataset card in one unpaged response. Output is the /datasets/index.json document: count, model_note, policy, and entries, plus the index title, description, and links. count is the number of cards. Each entries[] item is a full card: id, name, publisher, url, license (string or null), license_verified, license_url, approx_size, size_bytes (integer or null), format, access (open, login, or terms-acceptance), relevance, mirror_allowed, verified_at, http_status, archive_url, data_period, sample_url, and notes. This site's own library dataset is first. Cards are metadata: nothing is downloaded. There is no limit or offset. Takes no parameters: call with an empty object. Use get_dataset instead when you have an id and want that one card from /datasets/<id>/card.json. Use search_sources with category datasets-benchmarks instead for papers and benchmark sources, which are not these cards. Use list_changes instead for recent dataset edits (those ids use a dataset: prefix). A failed read returns isError. The text is the Error message (Fetch failed <status> <url> when the HTTP status is not OK), or Dataset list failed. when the failure is not an Error. Free, no auth.
name: list_datasets
title: List dataset cards
